Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Ketchikan Area Office 2030 Sea Level Drive, Suite 205 Ketchikan, AK 99901

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: August 4, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Bo Meredith Ketchikan Area Management Biologist bo.meredith@alaska.gov (907) 225-5195

2026 NEETS BAY TERMINAL HARVEST AREA FISHERIES ANNOUNCEMENT

The Southern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association (SSRAA) has achieved their cost recovery goal and secured summer chum salmon broodstock. The Neets Bay Terminal Harvest Area (THA) will open for rotational fisheries beginning at 5:00 a.m., Thursday, August 6, 2026.

The Neets Bay THA (101-95) will open in those waters east of the longitude of the easternmost tip of Bug Island at 131°39.14′ W long (Bug Island line) and west of the barrier net at the head of the bay (Figure 1). Fishermen are advised to use extreme caution when operating near the barrier net and be aware that the barrier net may billow during ebb tides. Although SSRAA has secured its broodstock needs, damage to the net will result in the suspension of fishery rotations to repair the barrier net and safeguard broodstock. Additionally, fishermen are reminded that tour boats and float planes that transit the area need safe and convenient access to the dock.

From 5:00 a.m., Thursday, August 6, through 5:00 a.m., Saturday, August 29, 2026, salmon may be taken in the Neets Bay THA by drift gillnet and purse seine gear as follows:

Purse Seine

5:00 a.m., Thursday, August 6, to 5:00 a.m., Friday, August 7; 5:00 a.m., Monday, August 10, to 5:00 a.m., Tuesday, August 11; 5:00 a.m., Friday, August 14, to 5:00 a.m., Saturday, August 15; 5:00 a.m., Tuesday, August 18, to 5:00 a.m., Wednesday, August 19; 5:00 a.m., Saturday, August 22, to 5:00 a.m., Sunday, August 23; 5:00 a.m., Wednesday, August 26, to 5:00 a.m., Thursday August 27;

Drift Gillnet

5:00 a.m., Saturday, August 8, to 5:00 a.m., Sunday, August 9; 5:00 a.m., Wednesday, August 12, to 5:00 a.m., Thursday, August 13; 5:00 a.m., Sunday, August 16, to 5:00 a.m., Monday, August 17; 5:00 a.m., Thursday, August 20, to 5:00 a.m., Friday, August 21; 5:00 a.m., Monday, August 24, to 5:00 a.m., Tuesday, August 25; 5:00 a.m., Friday, August 28, to 5:00 a.m., Saturday, August 29.

Fishermen, tenders, and processors are reminded that harvest from the Neets Bay THA should be kept separate and reported on a separate fish ticket from harvest outside of the Neets Bay THA.

Neets Bay THA Chinook Salmon Landing Restrictions for Purse Seine Gear: Chinook salmon 28 inches or greater in length may NOT be retained and Chinook salmon less than 28 inches may be retained but not sold.

When under nonretention of Chinook salmon 28 inches or larger, purse seine fishermen are encouraged to quickly release Chinook salmon in a manner that minimizes mortality. If Chinook salmon greater than 28 inches (large) are retained, the fisherman is in violation and may be issued a citation. Retained large Chinook salmon will be donated, and the fisherman

The Emergency Order corresponding to this announcement is EO 1E2526.
